Name: Fish Traps
Author: AxelotlTheGreat
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Adds fish traps that act like crab pots that catch fish native to that area. These must be loaded with bait, and some have special effects when loaded with different baits. Magic bat eliminates trash and can catch fish from any season in that location. Wild bait has a chance for double catch, and deluxe bait catches silver quality fish.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]1 Click the download button.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]2 Unzip the file.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]3 Drag both files into the mods folder.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- Adds a new type of crab pot, the fish trap[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- Adds a new crafting recipe at fishing 8.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- Adds a new shop entry to Willy's shop.[/color][/size]


[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]- SMAPI[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Content Patcher[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Stardew Valley 1.6[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Shout out to my dad @dhfraser for helping me with this mod.[/color][/size]
